name: @ducatjs/compare
description: Reproducible comparison of ducat with other JavaScript money and decimal libraries: correctness battery, benchmark and bundle sizes.

scripts.battery: node build.mjs battery/run.ts out/battery.mjs && node out/battery.mjs > results/battery.json && node build.mjs fixed/run.ts out/fixed-battery.mjs && node out/fixed-battery.mjs > results/fixed-battery.json
scripts.battery:check: node build.mjs battery/run.ts out/battery.mjs && node out/battery.mjs > out/battery-node.json && node battery/check.ts results/battery.json out/battery-node.json && node build.mjs fixed/run.ts out/fixed-battery.mjs && node out/fixed-battery.mjs > out/fixed-battery-node.json && node battery/check.ts results/fixed-battery.json out/fixed-battery-node.json
